prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the person in <Picture 1>, shown again in close-up in <Picture 2>, preserving their exact identity, facial features, skin tone and hairstyle. <Picture 2> is the authority for the shape of their face and eyes.
summary:
[reference generation] <Subject 1> speaks one short line to camera in a quiet street at dusk, during one continuous shot.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - their identity, face shape, eye shape, nose, mouth, skin texture and hair remain recognizable and unchanged; only the location, the lighting, their clothing and their action are new.
detailed_description:
The target video is a single continuous take in a quiet residential street of low Japanese apartment buildings at dusk, with warm window light and a wide pale sky behind the rooftops. [Shot 1] A steady medium shot holds her standing on the pavement, the street receding softly behind her. She wears a dark bomber jacket over a plain white top, straight indigo denim and white trainers. She stands or sits very upright with her weight even on both feet; she never shifts her weight onto one hip and never crosses her legs. Her expression is calm and quietly observant, restrained rather than blank, and her gaze stays level on the camera lens. She stays still as the evening light falls. She looks at the camera and says clearly (S1) <d>[English] I am not good at asking for help. I am working on that.</d> Her mouth moves in exact synchronization with the words and her expression stays composed throughout; she does not smile broadly, perform warmth or gesture theatrically. Her large horizontally elongated almond eyes with visible sclera around the irises, her short brow-to-eye distance, her dark fairly straight brows, her lean youthful midface, her straight narrow nose with no dorsal hump, her softly rounded chin that does not jut forward, her skin texture and her black hair all remain exactly as they are in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, stable and physically coherent from the first frame to the last. There is no other speech.
overall_soundscape: A quiet residential street at dusk: distant traffic, faint birds, a far-off train, and the synchronized spoken line.
non_diegetic_music: A sparse, quiet piano figure held far under the voice, unresolved and unsentimental, at low level so the spoken line stays clearly in front.
